title: Direct Evidence for Octupole Deformation in 146Ba and the Origin of Large E1 Moment Variations in Reflection-Asymmetric Nuclei
scope: Follow-up to the 144Ba direct-E3 evidence ladder; not part of the original 127 rows.
read_scope: Six-page arXiv/published-version manuscript read end-to-end; experiment, GOSIA, Table I, E1/E3 discussion, SCCM/GCM interpretation and alternatives checked.
increment: Adds an independent neighboring-isotope direct E3 result: B(E3;3−→0+)=48(+21/−29) W.u., approximately equal to 144Ba, while the E1 dipole moment is strongly suppressed by neutron-orbital occupancy.
independence: Independent 146Ba Coulomb-excitation measurement, same broad CHICO2/GRETINA program as 144Ba; treat as related experimental lineage rather than an exact duplicate.
limitations: GOSIA rigid-rotor coupling released only for uncertainty evaluation
E1 matrix elements have weak sensitivity
SCCM assumes axial quadrupole/octupole collective coordinates
arXiv copy used for local audit
